test_cases.title: UAT-PLAN-IND-1: Read the dictionary and the entry rules
test_cases.oracle_source: Claim → FR-IND-01, FR-IND-02; kỳ vọng nguyên văn của ca thiết kế UAT-PLAN-IND-1 (Design/MACHVON_Design/03_Engineering/test_cases.json)
test_cases.catches_bug: Hành vi của UAT-PLAN-IND-1 khác kết quả mong đợi của thiết kế
test_cases.steps:
Chuẩn bị: Starting dictionary of the platform, no approved entry rule, a tenant rule that blocks a cumulative above the total investment.
1. Read the dictionary and the entry rules
2. Try CUMULATIVE 9 against TOTAL_INVESTMENT 1 with and without templates
3. Approve the rule and try again
test_cases.expected: Step 1: derived indicators are not enterable and the starting rules are templates; step 2: allowed without templates, blocked with them; step 3: blocked by the approved rule only.

test_cases.title: UAT-PLAN-IND-2: Enter equity 400, loan 500, total 1000
test_cases.oracle_source: Claim → FR-IND-01, FR-IND-02; kỳ vọng nguyên văn của ca thiết kế UAT-PLAN-IND-2 (Design/MACHVON_Design/03_Engineering/test_cases.json)
test_cases.catches_bug: Hành vi của UAT-PLAN-IND-2 khác kết quả mong đợi của thiết kế
test_cases.steps:
Chuẩn bị: Project, open period, locked period, rules: equity plus loan equals total (block), progress above 90 percent (warn).
1. Enter equity 400, loan 500, total 1000
2. Enter equity 400, loan 600, total 1000 and progress 95
3. Enter the same plan figure again
4. Enter a different plan figure without a reason, then with one
5. Enter into the locked period
test_cases.expected: Step 1: 422 IND_ENTRY_RULE_VIOLATED and nothing written; step 2: revision 1 with the warning in the audit trail; step 3: unchanged; step 4: 422 on reason, then revision 2; step 5: 409 PERIOD_LOCKED.

test_cases.title: UAT-PLAN-IND-3: Dry run F-1 through the sample mapping
test_cases.oracle_source: Claim → FR-IND-03; kỳ vọng nguyên văn của ca thiết kế UAT-PLAN-IND-3 (Design/MACHVON_Design/03_Engineering/test_cases.json)
test_cases.catches_bug: Hành vi của UAT-PLAN-IND-3 khác kết quả mong đợi của thiết kế
test_cases.steps:
Chuẩn bị: Form file F-1 with 5 rows (one project outside the scope, one unknown period, one blocked by a rule, one with a number that differs from the held one), layout flagged PENDING-EXTERNAL.
1. Dry run F-1 through the sample mapping
2. Dry run and apply F-1 through the approved mapping
3. Apply F-1 again
test_cases.expected: Step 1: 409 IND_MAPPING_NOT_APPROVED; step 2: dry run writes nothing, apply writes the valid figures with the file, line and mapping version, the refused rows are in the error report with line, field and code and the differing number is a difference; step 3: already loaded.
